<title level="1" right="Spell 5" pfs="Limited">
[Umbral Journey](/Spells.aspx?ID=1729)
<actions string="" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Concentrate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=32" />
<trait label="Manipulate" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=104" />
<trait label="Shadow" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=143" />
<trait label="Teleportation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=156" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Player Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=216) pg. 364

**Traditions**
[Arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1), [Occult](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=3)

**Deities**
[Count Ranalc](/Deities.aspx?ID=92), [Luhar](/Deities.aspx?ID=216), [Zon-Kuthon](/Deities.aspx?ID=296)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** 1 minute

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** touch

**Target** you and up to 10 willing creatures touched
</row>

<row gap="medium">

**Duration** 8 hours
</row>

</column>

---

You move partially into the Netherworld, using its warped nature to speed your travels. Each hour, you cover roughly as much ground as you normally would in 3 days (page 438). The landmarks are vague and symbolic rather than concrete, leaving you within a mile of your intended destination when you Dismiss the spell or its duration ends.
name: Umbral Journey
